text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —The preparations were complete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want to time my run under conditions 
that feel close to the real thing." 
Having made this request, Daring Tact 
appeared 
wearing her racing silks.
choice_data_list:
Your racing silks are so white and 
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! 
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
White is—to me, 
a very special color.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Like a morning blanketed in freshly fallen 
snow, 
purely immaculate, without a single 
blemish—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to charge straight toward victory 
with a clear heart. 
Desiring to keep my spirit that way, I 
chose white.
choice_data_list:
That's the perfect reason for choosing 
your racing silks!

That's a wonderful reason for your racing 
silks.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
...However, there is one more reason.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
For me, white carries— 
an unforgettable meaning.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I must have been about seven years old— 
A neighbor took me along into the 
mountains 
to check on their traps.

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Neighbor Man
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there, Tact! 
Are ya scared?"

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"N-No! 
Just a little bit...!"

text_block_list.name: Neighbor Man
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let's take a quick 
breather! 
I packed some miso soup in a thermos, so 
let's have some of that!"

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much! 
Heave... ho—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: It happened just as I set my pack down—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Whrrooooo...)

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "...The wind... is strong..."

text_block_list.name: Neighbor Man
text_block_list.text: "—Uh oh."

text_block_list.name: Neighbor Man
text_block_list.text: "Get behind that rock!!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BOOOOOM!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—It was a roar as if lightning had struck 
down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Sheltered behind the rock, I clutched my 
head 
and froze on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: It was an avalanche.

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "...Ngh, ...aaahhh!!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it occurred 
on a slope a little further away—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yet, despite the distance, 
I felt it vividly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Swallowing towering trees whole— 
a menacing force sweeping forward without 
mercy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
And yet...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Terror wasn't the only thing 
the avalanche brought in its wake.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —White.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: A white that made me tremble.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Countless drifts kicked up by the 
avalanche 
danced through the air like plumes of 
white smoke, 
simply—glistening.

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ".........So pretty."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A cloud of snow smoke. As it drifted in 
trails of white, 
it felt almost as though I was standing 
inside the clouds.

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I was scared. 
And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: "Why... is it so... beautiful...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That day was the first time I realized 
just how small of an existence I was 
in the presence of nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
My knees were still trembling. 
Deep inside my chest, that roaring boom 
kept echoing on and on.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Someone like me... 
could never compare to that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even so— 
...I couldn't look away.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That wild, ferocious, yet breathtaking 
spectacle 
has stayed burned into my heart ever 
since.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Charging toward victory with a heart 
clear and unburdened by anything.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And when I run— 
I want to be overwhelming and beautiful, 
just like that snow.
choice_data_list:
So it's the color of pure devotion and 
strength.

A sight forever burned into your heart, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let us engrave this spotless, pure 
white—into history.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I hold it in awe and reverence, 
but never in fear.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I want to be just like that snow.
